summary: Issue #269 replaces the /settings placeholder with an authenticated operator-safe configuration and diagnostics workspace composed from existing session and client-safe runtime contracts. The slice exposes sanitized organization, role and deployment context plus versioned browser-local presentation preferences without adding a universal settings API, backend schema, secrets or unsafe system mutations.
planned_scope: authenticated operator identity and organization context
roles and effective permissions grouped for operator comprehension
sanitized API, WebSocket and browser-origin diagnostics
ready, incomplete and unsafe configuration states
canonical navigation to existing operational workflows
focused tests and authenticated browser acceptance with zero backend mutations
guardrails: no secret, token, password, cookie or opaque credential exposure
no node, device, Modbus or hardware write
no alarm-rule, retention, backup, restore, TLS, DNS, VPN or deployment mutation
no database migration or universal settings API
no dependency migration or unrelated refactor
verification_plan: focused unit tests for URL sanitization and configuration-state derivation
focused tests for versioned preference parsing, malformed recovery and reset
format, lint, strict TypeScript, relevant Vitest and production build
authenticated browser proof for organization/session context and sanitized diagnostics
browser proof for preference persistence and reset
offline dependency review proportional to changed runtime surface

hardware_evidence.note: Issue #269 is software-only. No Raspberry Pi, physical RS-485 device, Modbus command, hardware write or production/site cutover is permitted.
